specs.title: Boots to the title (normal + lowfx) with 0 console errors / unhandled rejections
specs.method: Fresh browser context per mode (`?lowfx=1&mute=1`, and `?mute=1` in full runs), real-time loop running; wait for phase `title` + 3 s; read `__qs.errors` and page console errors/pageerrors; composited screenshot must not be blank. Boot time vs the 3 s budget is reported (warn only, SwiftShader).
specs.details: lowfx: boot 7844 ms, 0 errors, 0 warnings; normal: boot 3972 ms, 0 errors, 0 warnings · lowfx: boot 7844 ms > 3 s budget (headless SwiftShader) · normal: boot 3972 ms > 3 s budget (headless SwiftShader)

specs.title: All 13 endings run to completion (script-driven) with __qs.errors empty
specs.method: Ending sweep (tests/lib/endings.mjs): each scenario on a freshly loaded page, played from `qs.start` to the ending card with `__qa.tick`; `__qs.errors` and console errors are collected per scenario (all attempts).
specs.details: 13/13 endings reached the card; 0 with errors.

specs.title: 10 consecutive rounds (retry / rewrite / title) without crash; GPU memory plateaus after round 3
specs.method: One page, 10 rounds: start → retry → rewrite (real UI: preset tab + 写好了 + hold-to-crumple) → title → … Each round throws at crush / floor / trash in turn (perfect, lost, three_pointer sets) and plays to the card. At every card: `renderer.info.memory`, JS heap, errors. Endings are rendered every 1.5 s so `renderer.info.memory` sees real uploads. Leak check: 4 of the rounds are then replayed twice with identical seed + target (content already uploaded); geometries/textures must not grow between the two replay passes (tolerance 2). First-use growth (new characters' faces, lazily built sets) is reported but not a failure.

specs.title: After any ending, 再来一局 returns to a clean aim view
specs.method: For every ending in the sweep: `cardChoice("retry")` (falls back to clicking 再来一局) → intro → aim + 0.8 s; compare with the fresh-round aim snapshot taken before the throw: phase/timeScale=1/not paused/cam fp/stage classroom/input enabled/ball held, no new full-screen DOM overlays, top/bottom band not black (letterbox), overall luminance within ±40 % (fade/flash), one render call per frame (no PiP), no HUD line of the fresh view missing (digits and names normalised; new lines such as lecture bubbles are ignored).
specs.details: 13 retries checked.

specs.title: Real input: title → gender → letter (preset + custom) → hold to crumple → intro → aim
specs.method: Natural real-time mode (rAF loop + SwiftShader rendering), Playwright clicks on visible labels (我是男生/开始/preset title/自己写/写好了), keyboard typing into the textarea, `mouse.down` held until the phase leaves `letter`, one click to skip the intro. Pass 1 uses a preset; then the round is finished (manual fast-forward) and 改写情书 is clicked for pass 2 with custom text. Checks `ctx.round.letter` = exactly what was chosen/typed and phase `aim` with `cam.mode` fp.
specs.details:
preset: phase aim, letter "今天的夕阳很好看。
如果能和你一起看…"; custom: phase aim, letter "放学后的走廊很长，我想和你一起走完它…". Intro skip: 1019 ms, 6712 ms.

specs.title: Real input: moving the mouse in aim changes the view within angle limits
specs.method: Fresh round at aim (teacher forced writing). Playwright `mouse.move` to centre / left / right / top / bottom edges, 1.5 s of game time each (manual stepping). Camera yaw/pitch are read from the rendered camera's world direction. Pass: left > centre > right yaw, top > bottom pitch, yaw range ≥ 40°, pitch range ≥ 20°, |yaw| ≤ 90°, pitch within [−60°, 60°].

specs.title: Real input: hold LMB charges (power rises, arm lifts) → release throws, camera follows
specs.method: Fresh aim round. `document.elementFromPoint` at the press point must be the game canvas. Real `mouse.down` → 0.7 s manual stepping: `aim.charging`, `aim.power` rising, mean camera-local Y of the meshes parented to the camera (FP arms) must rise > 1 cm. `mouse.up` → within 0.2 s ball `flying`, phase `flight`, `ball:launched`; within 0.5 s `cam.mode` = follow; launch heading within 10° of the view yaw.
specs.details: power 0.174→0.331→0.471→0.595→0.702→0.793→0.868; arms ΔY 3.5 cm; after release flight/flying/cam follow; heading Δ 0.0°.

specs.title: Real input: hold RMB / Space to pretend to study — suspicion drops, charging impossible
specs.method: Fresh aim round, teacher forced `watching`, suspicion 0.6. (1) real right-button hold 1.5 s: `aim.studying`, suspicion falls ≥ 0.15, camera pitch drops (looks at the book). (2) real Space hold, then real LMB press 0.6 s: no charging, power 0; release: no launch. (3) LMB charge then Space mid-charge: `aim:cancel`, release does not throw.
specs.details: study: suspicion 0.525→0, pitch 0°→-50°; Space+LMB power 0; cancel events [aim:study,aim:cancel,aim:study].

specs.title: Real input in flight: C cycles camera styles; Space = slow motion; A/D shift the landing point
specs.method: Same seed + same solved throw (first solvable of r0c3 / r0c2 / r1c3 / r0c4 / podium) replayed on fresh pages. Baseline twice (determinism), then real Space+D held from 0.15 s after launch, then Space+A, then KeyC presses. Pass: baselines identical (< 1 cm), Space → timeScale < 0.9 and `ball:willpower {on:true}`, D and A each move the landing ≥ 0.15 m and to opposite sides, each C press changes the follow style (cam:mode event with a different style or camera→ball offset change > 25°).
specs.details: baseline desk@r0c3; determinism Δ 0.000 m; Space+D Δ 1.02 m (timeScale 0.30, willpower true); Space+A Δ 2.33 m; C styles ["side","fpStay","cinematic"].

specs.title: Real input: Esc pauses (game time stops), resuming continues
specs.method: Aim: real `Escape` press, 1 s of stepping → `ctx.time.now` must not advance, pause menu text visible; resume by clicking 继续 → time advances again. Flight: Escape mid-flight → ball position frozen across 1 s of stepping; resume with Escape.
specs.details: aim: Δt paused 0.000 s, after resume 1.00 s; flight: ball moved 0.0000 m while paused.

specs.title: Timer reaching zero → coward ending
specs.method: Fresh round with `roundSeconds: 6`, teacher forced writing, no input. HUD text is sampled at t = 1 s and 3 s (the timer should be visible and change). Step until the ending phase: expect `round:timeout`, `bell`, `endingId` = coward.
specs.details: timeLeft 5.0 → 3.0; events round:timeout,bell,phase; ending coward.

specs.title: solveLaunch + launch lands on the target seat for ≥ 90 % of solvable seats (29 seats)
specs.method: Physics sandbox (tests swallow ball:launched/landed so the round stays in aim): quiet class (`setAmbient(false)`), teacher forced writing, wind frozen. For every non-player seat: `solveLaunch(__qs.target(seat))` → `launch` → step until landed. Hit = Landing desk/chair with that seatId. Full run: seeds 11 and 23 (different occupants); quick: seed 11, every 3rd seat. Also reports unsolvable seats and solver-prediction mismatches.
specs.details: 56/57 solvable seats hit (98.2 %), 1/58 unsolvable; solve time avg 38 ms, max 151 ms. unsolvable: r0c1(s11) · misses: r0c1(s23)→floor@- [solver predicted a hit]

specs.title: 200 random throws: 0 NaN, 0 tunnelling, all land within 8 s
specs.method: Physics sandbox, quiet class, teacher frozen, wind frozen. Seeded random yaw ∈ [−85°, 85°], pitch ∈ [−15°, 75°], power ∈ [0, 1] via `gameplay.launch`. Every tick: finite pos/vel; centre never leaves the room except through the open window w1 (crossing point checked); never crosses a thin desk/chair/podium/book slab from above its top to below its bottom inside its footprint. `ball:landed` must arrive within 8 s of game time. A fresh round every 50 throws.
specs.details: 200 throws; landings {"floor":163,"chair":7,"outside":9,"podium":4,"self":1,"desk":14,"fan":2}; slowest landing 2.23 s.

specs.title: Bounces, rolling and settling are plausible; a head hit bounces off and triggers a reaction
specs.method: Sandbox. (1) A flat throw (pitch ~20°) onto a desk with the full position log: bounce apex heights must decrease, the ball must come to rest (drift < 5 mm over 1 s after ball:landed), roll distance after first contact < 1.5 m; 6 frames from a QA side camera go to qa/shots/C3/ for review. (2) In the normal flow (reactions only run in `flight`), flat throws at the heads of the nearest classmates in front (ballistic aim at the head centre): a `ball:hit` tagged head must occur, the post-hit velocity must point away from the head, and a reaction must follow within 1.5 s (`student:event` or `ai.students.react` for that id, or an expression/clip change visible as a student:event).
specs.details: desk: {"landing":"desk@r2c1","bounces":4,"apexes":[0.81],"roll":0,"drift":0,"flight":1.483}; head: sun_xiaokong hit at 4.42 m/s, bounced away true, reactions [hit] character calls [setExpression(dizzy), emote(?), play(sitIdle), setExpression(neutral), play(sitIdle)].

specs.title: Teacher writing → warning → watching cycle; warning tell lasts 0.5–0.9 s and is visible/audible
specs.method: Fresh round, AI unforced, player idle looking at the board; observe 60 s of game time (30 s quick). From `teacher:state` events: the sequence must contain writing→warning→watching; every warning lasts 0.5–0.9 s (game time). Tell: during each warning the teacher character gets a clip/emote/lookAt/expression call, a bubble/say, or the head rotates ≥ 4° (visible), and an audio event appears in `ctx.audio.debug.recent` or an `audio.sfx` call (audible). FP screenshots of writing / warning / watching.
specs.details: states: watching; writing; warning; drinking; writing; warning; watching; writing; warning; watching; writing; warning; watching; warnings 0.6s→drinking, 0.517s→watching, 0.7s→watching, 0.75s→watching; tells e.g. ["play(idle)","lookAt(vec)","emote(?)"] / ["{\"t\":7.533,\"kind\":\"sfx\",\"name\":\"stingDanger\",\"auto\":true}","{\"t\":7.533,\"kind\":\"sfx\",\"name\":\"hmm\",\"auto\":true}"].

specs.title: Teacher facing class + player in view + continuous charging → teacher:caught within 3 s
specs.method: Fresh round, teacher forced `watching`, suspicion 0, `ctx.input.simulate({down:"Mouse0"})` held. Measure game time from the first tick where `teacher.canSee(PLAYER_EYE)` (or charging visibility) is true to `teacher:caught`. Repeated for 3 seeds; all must be ≤ 3 s.
specs.details: seed 16: in view at 0.02 s, caught at 1.97 s

specs.title: Studying lowers suspicion; charging with the teacher's back turned does not raise it
specs.method: Fresh round. (a) teacher forced watching, suspicion 0.6, simulated RMB (study) 1.5 s → must drop ≥ 0.15. (b) teacher forced writing, suspicion 0.2, simulated LMB charging 3 s → must not rise (≤ +0.005); then the charge is cancelled with Space so nothing is thrown.
specs.details: study 0.59→0.00 in 1.5 s; back-turned charging 0.193→max 0.190 over 3 s.

specs.title: A ball flying long enough inside the teacher's view cone → teacherSawBall
specs.method: Fresh round, teacher forced watching, suspicion 0; high lob to a front-row desk / the podium. Counts flight time with `teacher.canSee(ball.pos)`; after landing `ctx.round.teacherSawBall` must be true (and `teacher:caught {reason:"ball"}` emitted). Control: same throw with the teacher forced writing → teacherSawBall false.
specs.details: watching: 1.99s in view → saw true (wrong_caught); writing control → saw false (wrong_accept).

specs.title: ≥ 6 in-flight accidents can be triggered with ai.students.trigger and are visible
specs.method: Per kind (stretch, raiseHand, standUp, sneeze, catch, witness, gust, teacherTurn), three deterministic flights on fresh pages (seed 24, quiet class, teacher forced writing, lob to the podium; trigger 0.2 s into the flight with no id, so the AI picks the classmate nearest the path): (1) discover who/what is affected from `student:event`/`incident`; (2) control without trigger and (3) with trigger, both rendered by a close QA camera on the affected classmate (or the open window for gust, the teacher for teacherTurn) just before and 0.7 s after the trigger time. Visible = the affected character's maximum bone displacement over those 0.7 s exceeds max(1.5 × control, control + 6 cm) (a pixel metric was too noisy because classmates track the ball with their gaze); gust = `classroom.wind.strength` peak > 0.3 plus a pixel change at the window (wind is not frozen here). Screenshots are for eyeballing. Pass: ≥ 6 kinds return true, emit an event and are visible. Screenshots: qa/shots/D5/<kind>.png (after) and <kind>-before.png.

specs.title: All 13 endings reachable by deterministic scripts; resolve() matches the GDD §7 table
specs.method: (1) Ending sweep: one scenario per ending (tests/lib/endings.mjs) with fixed seeds; each attempt checks the physical precondition (e.g. landed on the crush's desk, unseen) and then that `ctx.round.endingId` is the expected ending. >1 attempt needed = unstable (warn). (2) `ctx.story.resolve()` is called on 24 synthetic rounds built from the live roster (all GDD §7 rows + priority edges); strict rows must match, interpretation rows only warn.
specs.details: 13/13 scripted endings OK; resolve table 24/24. perfect: unstable — needed attempt #2 (crush#0:xia_mo@r0c1 → no launch solution)

specs.title: Each ending lasts 8–45 s, has its own camera work / dialogue / music, ends on the card; key frames all differ
specs.method: From the ending sweep recording (phase `ending` → `card`): game-time duration in [8, 45] s; ≥ 1 dialogue line (`say` event) or caption; camera work = ≥ 1 cut or ≥ 30 frames of camera motion; at least one music track other than classroom/flight/title in `ctx.audio.debug.music` (or an `audio.music` call); card text contains the ending title (the part after ·, the card shows the tag separately). Key frames: the canvas thumbnail at the story climax beat (else +5 s) of every pair of endings must differ (mean abs diff > 6/255).

specs.title: caught_read reads the player's own (custom) letter verbatim
specs.method: The sweep's caught_read scenario starts with the custom letter "教室第四排的风都知道，我偷看了你一百零八次<3" (contains "<3" to catch HTML escaping bugs). While the ending plays, the visible DOM text is sampled every 0.1 s; the full normalised letter must appear on screen (typewriter allowed) or in a `say`/`letterReveal` text. Read-aloud evidence: `audio.speak` / speechSynthesis with the full text, or dialogue blips.

specs.title: Gallery: unlocks persist across reloads; locked endings show hints; new unlocks show NEW
specs.method: Fresh browser context (empty localStorage). Play coward (roundSeconds 3) twice: first card must say NEW and `ending:shown.isNew` true, second must not. Reload: `story.gallery.unlocked()` and localStorage `qingshu.endings` still contain it. On the title screen click 结局图鉴 (fallback `ui.gallery()`): the unlocked title is listed and ≥ 90 % of locked endings show their `hint` text; screenshot.
specs.details: first card isNew=true NEW-text=true; repeat isNew=false; after reload unlocked=["coward"]; gallery via role=button name=/^结局图鉴/: 12/12 hints.

specs.title: Follow cam keeps the ball in the central 70 % in ≥ 90 % of flight frames; never hidden by nearby geometry
specs.method: Every throw of the ending sweep (≈ 11 flights, different targets) is sampled each tick while phase = flight, ball flying and `cam.mode` = follow: the ball centre is projected with the render camera; in-centre = in front and |ndc x|,|y| ≤ 0.7. Every 3rd frame 5 rays (centre ± ball radius) are cast from the camera against visible opaque meshes: all 5 blocked by something < 1 m from the camera = "hidden by nearby geometry". Also flags the camera inside a static collider box. The camera module's own `cam.metrics` ratio is shown for comparison.
specs.details: 11 flights, 2218 follow frames: 100 % in the central 70 %; per flight perfect 100%, same_gender 100%, wrong_caught 100%, wrong_accept 100%, chalk_counter 100%, graded 100%, three_pointer 100%, out_window 100%, confetti 100%, self_love 100%, lost 100%. ball fully hidden by geometry < 1 m from the lens: out_window ×2 (curtains<classroom)

specs.title: Every throw triggers bullet time at least once; timeScale returns to 1 afterwards
specs.method: Sweep flights: minimum `engine.timeScale` while the ball flies must be < 0.85. Afterwards: timeScale must be exactly 1 when the ending card is up, and 1 again in the aim phase after 再来一局.
specs.details: 11 flights, min timeScale perfect 0.1, same_gender 0.1, wrong_caught 0.1, wrong_accept 0.1, chalk_counter 0.1, graded 0.1, three_pointer 0.1, out_window 0.1, confetti 0.1, self_love 0.1, lost 0.1.

specs.title: Teacher turning mid-flight opens the PiP window
specs.method: Fresh round, quiet class, teacher forced writing; long lob to the podium; 0.3 s into the flight (a) `ai.students.trigger("teacherTurn")`, (b) in a second run `forceTeacher("watching")`. Within 0.6 s the PiP must be detectable: > 1 renderer.render call per frame, or `cam.debug().pip`, or a `cam.pip(true)` call. Screenshot of the PiP.

specs.title: Transitions (heart iris, fades, white flash, letterbox) leave no residue
specs.method: Uses the A4 retry snapshots of every ending: `cam.debug()` must be idle: fade/flash/letterbox/vignette/speed lines 0, iris `open`, no PiP/custom render, roll 0, no slow-mo requests, no extra full-screen DOM overlays, composited screenshot luminance within ±40 % of a fresh aim view and no black top/bottom bands. Highlights endings that use irisHeart/fade/flash/letterbox (from the camera call spy).

specs.title: AudioContext running after the first click; music track switches per phase
specs.method: Unmuted page (`?lowfx=1`). AudioContext instances are tracked from document start. Real click on 我是男生 → context state must be `running`. One round through the real UI (letter, crumple, intro) then scripted aim → throw → ending; `ctx.audio.debug.music` is recorded at every phase change. Expect title→title, aim→classroom, flight→flight, ending→an ending track (romance, comedy, …). Signal level at the destination is sampled (analyser) for information.

specs.method: Same unmuted round as H1 (real crumple, intro bell, forced teacher warning, charging, throw onto a desk). Every new entry of `ctx.audio.debug.recent` is collected each tick; each required name must appear. Names seen only through `ctx.audio.sfx` call spies (not in debug.recent) give a warning.

specs.title: Master volume 0 = total silence; settings persist
specs.method: Unmuted page. Every connection to the AudioContext destination is routed through a QA analyser (installed before boot). Title → 设置 → the 主音量 slider is set to 0 with a real fill → sfx("ding") + sfx("bell") + title music → peak at the destination must be < 1e-4 over 0.6 s. Sanity: at 0.8 the same sounds must be audible (peak > 1e-3), otherwise the measurement is inconclusive. Reload → `ctx.settings.masterVolume` and localStorage `qingshu.settings` keep 0. Also `?mute=1` boot must be silent and must not persist: reloading the same profile without mute=1 must restore audible volume.
specs.details: start masterVolume 0.8; peak default 0.5133, master 0 0.000000, after reload 0.000000 (masterVolume 0), ?mute=1 0.000000, masterVolume after a mute boot + normal reload 0.8; set via ui slider.

Max over views must be within budget.

specs.title: lowfx: average tick time (no rendering) ≤ 4 ms
specs.method: lowfx page, manual mode. `engine.tick(1/60)` is timed with performance.now() (yields between ticks are not counted) over 10 s of aim with ambient classmates and the natural teacher, then a full flight, then 8 s of an ending. Reports avg / p95 / max per phase and the slowest update order slot is not measured (contract-level only). Machine-dependent: also compare with `node -e` CPU speed if it fails.
